cohort: The study included 250 women aged 18-35 years undergoing labor, divided into a tramadol group and a control group who refused analgesia.
finding: Intramuscular tramadol was found to be an effective, safe, and cost-effective analgesic for labor pain, significantly reducing pain and the caesarean section rate while improving neonatal outcomes with minimal maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: The tramadol study group had a lower caesarean section rate (10.4%) compared to the control group (22.4%).
